name.fr-FR: Catéchisme chrétien pour la vie intérieure (traduction anglaise de 1852)
name.en-US: Catechism of an Interior Life (1852 English translation)
name.pt-BR: Catecismo cristão para a vida interior (tradução inglesa de 1852)

description.fr-FR: La traduction anglaise anonyme de 1852 (Baltimore, Murphy) du Catéchisme chrétien d’Olier, en deux parties.
description.en-US: The anonymous 1852 English translation (Baltimore: Murphy) of Olier’s Christian Catechism, in two parts.
description.pt-BR: A tradução inglesa anônima de 1852 (Baltimore, Murphy) do Catecismo cristão de Olier, em duas partes.

sources.edition: A Catechism of an Interior Life, Baltimore: Fielding Lucas / Murphy & Co., 1852 (anonymous translation); archive.org OCR of the Toronto copy.
sources.description: OCR cleaned: running heads and page numbers removed, hyphenation joined. Lessons whose heading the OCR lost sit inside the previous lesson.
